name: decode-only-member-through-a-generic-client
description: A member only a decode fills is reported at possible where the value comes untyped from outside through the target's own generic client: the client returns what a fetch response's json() gives as its type parameter, so the analysis cannot see whether the caller of the outside call reads the member.
pending: confidence.19 through an in-repo generic client: the TypeScript analyzer reports a member an untyped outside value fills through the target's own generic function at certain.
